method.selection: Physical valid/finished only; highest fixed search merit, then unchanged raw drift score, then creation order. Displayed representative is separately highest unchanged valid score.
method.phases: Hierarchical: 16 anchor vectors, each line-only and line+existing speed plan (32 trials); 4 valid line specialists, 8 sequential line-locked fine trials each (32). Control: 64 existing adaptive/connection trials with a 4-member merit beam. Every failed, unchanged or duplicate proposal consumes one physical trial.
limitations: Fixed best-of-80 evolved parents; not evolution from prepared genesis.
One seed, four vehicles and 64 trials per arm do not establish a global optimum or vehicle capability.
Proxy search merit is predeclared, separate from unchanged production scoring; target agreement contributes only 5%.
State and forces are never assigned from a target. All physical evaluations start at Physics.initialState.
Sampled line perturbation has smooth zero endpoint derivatives before 128-knot discretization; runtime remains the unchanged linear genome sampler.
Endpoint genes do not guarantee endpoint physical states. Measured entry/exit differences are reported without teleporting or resetting the vehicle.
The existing stock model, including its current clutch/shift limitations, is held fixed.
This is not a timing benchmark; concurrent independent runs may change throughput, never budget or ordered selection.

interpretation: A higher final score alone is not proof of completed corner/straight connections.
Coarse-to-fine search is compared only from four fixed best-of-80 parents, not from prepared grip genesis.
Line-only versus line+speed pairs share their line vector; postselection stage maxima do not isolate a single cause.
Line-locked genes do not lock physical trajectories; valid fine descendants are compared with their original coarse physical path.
Zero-amplitude line vectors and all invalid/duplicate trials remain in the budget.
